results.title: Agent Retrieval Bench: Evaluating Repository Context Retrieval for Coding Agents
results.summary: Introduces a file-level benchmark that measures whether coding agents can retrieve the repository files needed for a task before patch generation, with 427 samples across 25 repositories and counterfactual retrieval cases. Finds no single retrieval family dominates and logged agent trajectories miss gold files on 27-35% of samples.

results.title: CORE-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Code Retrieval in the Era of Agentic Coding
results.summary: A benchmark evaluating code retrieval in agentic coding at three levels: code understanding, issue-to-edit localization, and broader context retrieval, containing over 180K queries and 106K relevance labels. Reports a sharp performance drop from traditional code search to agentic retrieval settings and shows supervised fine-tuning of embeddings helps.

results.title: On The Importance of Reasoning for Context Retrieval in Repository-Level Code Editing
results.summary: Investigates whether reasoning (chain-of-thought) helps LLMs gather relevant context from a repository before editing code. Concludes reasoning improves the precision of retrieved context but models still cannot reliably judge when the gathered context is sufficient.

results.title: Building a better repository map with tree-sitter
results.summary: The canonical write-up of Aider's repo map: it parses the codebase with tree-sitter into an AST, builds a directed graph of symbols and references, and uses a PageRank-style ranking to select the most relevant definitions within the LLM's token budget. This map is sent with each request instead of whole files.

results.title: How Cody understands your codebase
results.summary: Sourcegraph's official explanation of how Cody retrieves repository context for its AI coding assistant: chat/commands combine local IDE context with remote BM25-ranked search across selected repositories, while autocomplete uses tree-sitter intent classification over local context. Also explains why Cody moved away from embeddings-based retrieval at scale.
